values.note: Free first-come developed-dispersed camping in the Gandy Creek Dispersed Camping area. Camping only at campsites designated by a campsite sign; no more than two vehicles per campsite. Monongahela limit: 14 cumulative days at one site within 28 days.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/gandy-creek-dispersed-area (Order 21-87, prohibited within the Gandy Creek Dispersed Camping area along State Route 29: 'Camping, except at campsites designated by a campsite sign', 'Possessing, parking or leaving more than two vehicles ... per campsite') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/general-use-restrictions ('Camping outside developed campgrounds at any one campsite in excess of fourteen (14) cumulative days within a 28-day period') + Monongahela NF release reprinted by Parsons Advocate 2023-04-24 ('developed-dispersed campsites available free of charge'; 'Gandy Creek Dispersed Camping (County Route 29)'), read 2026-10-21

summary: No Forest Service page names Swallow Rock as a campground (the only FS mention is the Swallow Rock bridge over Gandy Creek on CR 29, a 2020 DOH repair permit). The pin is on CR 29 (Whitmer Road) ~2 km north-east of the Gandy Creek pin, inside the stretch the forest calls the Gandy Creek Dispersed Camping area: booking confirmed free first-come, not reservable, plus the signed-site and two-vehicle rules and the 14-days-in-28 limit (same as entry 59). Gandy Creek is not on the 2026 fee list; the area 'opens when snow-free; toilets open 4/15' (2026), and its one vault toilet has been closed since August 11, 2026 (not recorded here, since no page puts it at this site). Free fees left. Not stated: site count, rig size. AWH note kept.
flags: Aggregator link in website: thedyrt.com. No Forest Service recreation page for Swallow Rock or Gandy Creek; agency page: the Gandy Creek forest order https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/gandy-creek-dispersed-area.
Missing phone: Cheat-Potomac Ranger District (304) 257-4488 (Monongahela 2023 release; https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/offices).

Name: no agency page calls this 'Swallow Rock Campground'; the Forest Service names only the Gandy Creek Dispersed Camping area (County Route 29). A human may want the name to say it is a Gandy Creek dispersed site.
Criteria (unconfirmed): no Forest Service page says what size rig the signed Gandy Creek sites take; inclusion rests on AWH's firsthand note.
